notes: North is up. Printed names: ELMORE (no suffix, recorded as Elmore Street), SYLVAN AVE., EDGEWOOD AV. (twice), LLEWELLYN AV., BORDEN (no suffix, recorded as Borden Street), WEBER ST., AGNES ST., DREMAN (no suffix, recorded as Dreman Street). Edgewood appears as two separate pieces: the 50 ft street from Elmore south to y~2688 ('Edgewood Avenue') and a 25 ft road at the lower left that runs east from x~455 at y~3880, turns SSE and then south to Dreman ('Edgewood Avenue (branch to Dreman)'); they do not connect on this sheet. Llewellyn likewise has a north piece (Elmore to a dead end at y~4081, 'Llewellyn Avenue') and a south piece (Dreman southward, sheet 607, 'Llewellyn Avenue (south of Dreman)'); the gap between is lot area. The 30 ft street between Llewellyn and Borden has no name printed (measured nearer 20 ft than 30 ft). Weber St. and Agnes St. are drawn in outline in the sheet-610 strip east of Borden; their T points are on Borden's centreline. Dreman is a gentle arc across the bottom (three bends recorded). The big '0' letters at the left are outside the surveyed area.
